name: AgentChangeBench
description: AgentChangeBench is a multi-dimensional evaluation framework designed to measure the robustness of tool-augmented language model agents to mid-dialogue goal shifts across enterprise domains. It includes 2,835 task sequences and five user personas, evaluating models on metrics such as task success rate, tool use efficiency, tool call redundancy rate, and goal-shift recovery time.
reputation: A recent benchmark with emerging interest for evaluating tool-using agents under mid-dialogue goal changes, but it has not yet seen broad community standardization.
notes: Highlights that high raw accuracy does not imply robustness under dynamic goals; introduces novel metrics for recovery and redundancy.
